Mechanics prototype 0.1

You are the unseen Creator. The creature is the god humanity knows. Decide whether to spend Spirit, persuade, or trust its autonomy.

Creator interventions

Rain is reliable and expensive. Persuasion is cheaper but the creature may decline. Doing nothing lets it learn independently.
